lane_boundary_fit — DRIVE lane op

• 資料種類:keypoints → table

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.lane_boundary_fit(points, *, side='unknown', ransac_threshold=0.18, ransac_iterations=300, initial_outlier_weight=0.25, seed=0)(要直接呼叫實作,import laneops; laneops.lane_boundary_fit(points, *, side='unknown', ransac_threshold=0.18, ransac_iterations=300, initial_outlier_weight=0.25, seed=0);從台帳取用則 opsdrive.get("lane_boundary_fit"))

• GPU:無(僅 CPU 參考實作)

用法

對俯視點(橫向 x、前向 y)穩健擬合車道邊界 x=c0+c1*y+c2*y²。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

既存 ransac_line を外れ値に強い初期直線として使い、その後Huber IRLSの二次曲線へ拡張する。強いS字、yが折り返す境界、地面平面でない点には使えない。

Parameters

points : (N, 2) keypoints

世界座標 (x lateral, y forward) [m]。順序は問わない。

side : {"left", "right", "unknown"}

後段が片側だけを車線中央へずらすための名前。

ransac_threshold, ransac_iterations, initial_outlier_weight, seed

直線/最終inlierの距離[m]、反復数、初期RANSAC外れ値のIRLS重み、固定乱数seed。

initial_outlier_weight=0.25は初期inlierを4倍優先しつつ、曲線上で初期直線から

外れた点を残すための固定値である。

Returns

table

coefficients(c0,c1,c2)、observed_y、inlier_mask、残差、RMS、確信度。

English: initialise with the existing 3-D ransac_line (z=0), then fit the boundary x(y) with a Huber robust quadratic. Point order does not matter. It centres and normalises y for rank, condition-number, and least-squares work, then returns coefficients in the original world coordinates. The final inlier design must have rank 3, at least three distinct y values, and bounded condition number; otherwise it returns valid=False instead of silently using a line. Hairpins where y is not single-valued are outside the contract and fail closed.

呼び出し例::

import numpy as np

import laneops

y = np.linspace(0., 20., 41); x = -1.75 + 0.002 * y*y

fit = laneops.lane_boundary_fit(np.c_[x, y], side="left", seed=7)

assert np.allclose(fit["coefficients"], [-1.75, 0., 0.002], atol=1e-10)
